dominant_memory_model: Hierarchical memory contexts with reset/delete lifetimes and multiple context implementations
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Statement, operator, and compiler context trees plus live context dumps
main_caution: Context misuse can hide leaks until reset points fire

dominant_memory_model: Owner-bound pools and pool statistics groups
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Strict ownership, parent-child pool boundaries, and low-friction pool accounting
main_caution: Pools alone do not provide hard global or per-tenant limits

dominant_memory_model: MEM_ROOT short-lifetime heaps plus scan-resistant buffer pool management
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Parser/planner MEM_ROOT-style arenas and old/new buffer-pool treatment
main_caution: Subsystem-local allocators become opaque unless charged into one global tree

dominant_memory_model: Buffer-manager-aware allocator and unified treatment of temporary and persistent memory
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Shared control plane for spillable operator pages and persistent pages
main_caution: Operator page layouts must be purpose-built to avoid serialization overhead

dominant_memory_model: Hierarchical memory trackers with hard and soft limits, sampling, and overcommit hooks
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Global-to-local budget tree, query kill or wait policy, and memory profiling
main_caution: Tracker noise increases if domains are not isolated and spillability is not modeled

dominant_memory_model: Global and local pools, sharded memtables, off-heap controls
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Sharded write-memory lanes and independently configurable mutable structures
main_caution: JVM assumptions and memtable-only focus are not directly portable

dominant_memory_model: Allocator-aware fragmentation management and compact encodings for small aggregates
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Background defrag for caches and compact transient structures
main_caution: These tactics fit caches and metadata, not the core MGA row store

dominant_memory_model: Split heap, native, page-cache, and code-cache accounting with scoped trackers
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Native or off-heap isolation, page-cache separation, and local grab-size batching
main_caution: Sizing heuristics are workload-sensitive and page-cache pressure is not enough by itself

dominant_memory_model: Parent-child circuit breakers with real-memory and request protection
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Admission control for request, fielddata, and in-flight work
main_caution: Heap-centric defaults must be adapted for native, off-heap, and JIT memory

dominant_memory_model: Shared cache with checkpoint-oriented durability and operation memory tracking
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Shared cache pressure signals, checkpoint-aware retention, and per-operation tracking
main_caution: Journal-oriented assumptions differ from ScratchBird MGA and anti-WAL direction

dominant_memory_model: Memory-aware segment loading and global allocator gates for vector workloads
best_ideas_for_scratchbird: Vector and ANN segment budgeting, load planning, and blocking admission
main_caution: Highly specialized toward vector segments rather than general database runtime memory
